title: Enrichment Operation Retry Permission Consistency

items.action: retry failed customer contact enrichment through an Operation

frontend.reason: The current Operation Detail UI has no Enrichment Retry affordance; this change aligns the existing backend retry capability only.

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.execute permission is reused.

audit.reason: Existing operation retry audit events are preserved.

frontend.reason: No frontend implementation changes are introduced.

ui_permissions.reason: No Enrichment Retry UI action currently exists to gate.

route_guard.reason: No frontend route changes are introduced.

forms.reason: No form behavior changes are introduced.

visual_qa.reason: No rendered UI changes are introduced.

frontend_tests.reason: No frontend executable behavior changes are introduced.

notes: Enrichment Retry starts the same scraper-backed enrichment capability as Enrichment Start and therefore requires fair_crm.scraper.execute. Bulk Email Retry retains fair_crm.fair_emails.execute, generic operation Retry retains fair_crm.operations.execute, and Scraper Retry is intentionally outside this focused change.
